newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound/dollar rate generally flat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound/dollar rate generally flat.

text.p: The Egyptian pound against the dollar was relatively unchanged in a sideways private sector market on Thursday but with slightly higher demand for dollars, bankers said.
"Compared to yesterday, there is some call on the dollar, with high liquidity in the Egyptian pound, so it's easy to place dollars," said one banker.
"It (the market) is about the same, but the dollar is demanded. The dollar is slightly improving against the Egyptian pound," another banker said.
"Nothing has changed in the market. Demand and supply are normal but it's basically sideways," said a third banker.
Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3925 to 3.3955 pounds bid and 3.3955 and 3.3970 pounds offered in the interbank market.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3942 bid and 3.3963 offered compared to 3.3939 bid and 3.3956 offered on Wednesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.391424 buy and 3.397363 sell. -- Cairo newsroom +20 2 578 3290/1
